control: original joint-selector SWA_WINDOW10 parameter mean, cached audited refit prediction
source_trajectory: original TABM_TIME_SWA_V1 and approved continuation, selected refit-window of the same source directory/split/unit
method: equal prediction mean of every saved raw state in selected refit's last 10 completed epochs; use original fit preprocessing and inverse target transform; no initialization; no new epoch selection
raw_states_per_window: min(10, selected_epoch); original refit selected epochs all >=10
inferences: production full raw-state predictions and independent cold reversed/chunked replay; no new control inference
comparison: same-seed complete OOF gains versus Q75 and paired original SWA; across seeds summarize scalar metrics only
seed_history: all four already used to design this optimization; post-selection exploration, not independent confirmation
exploration_rule: retain sole candidate if complete four-seed mean versus Q75 and paired mechanism mean positive; record all seed signs and one-sided t-LCB95(df3) descriptively; no automatic platform scheduling
failure_policy: preserve exact failed evidence; no scientific refit, overwrite or automatic retry; authorized zero-fit engineering repair only
